compiled_state.title: Create test-design-md-fixtures.sh verifying linter behavior and latency
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: design-md-lint.sh blocks on each violation file and passes on each clean file
- dd-4: Cold-start and warm-cache latency recorded; cold-start >30s emits advisory

## Implementation
Create tests/scripts/test-design-md-fixtures.sh using assert.sh.
- Precondition: check design-md-lint.sh exists, skip with advisory if absent
- Iterate violation-* fixtures: assert non-zero exit from linter
- Iterate clean-* fixtures: assert zero exit from linter
- Record cold-start and warm-cache latency via SECONDS
- Emit ADVISORY line if cold-start >30s (exit 0 — advisory, not failure)
- Output: LATENCY cold_start=Ns warm_cache=Ns
- chmod +x

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Test script exists and executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-design-md-fixtures.sh
- [ ] Sources assert.sh — Verify: grep -q 'assert.sh' tests/scripts/test-design-md-fixtures.sh
- [ ] Handles missing design-md-lint.sh gracefully — Verify: grep -qE 'SKIP|not found' tests/scripts/test-design-md-fixtures.sh
- [ ] Records latency — Verify: grep -c 'SECONDS' tests/scripts/test-design-md-fixtures.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 2)}'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker — Verify: grep '\[test_design_md_fixtures\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
